title: Unique Paths
statement: A robot starts at the top-left of an m by n grid and may only move right or down. Return how many distinct paths reach the bottom-right corner.
constraints: the answer fits in a 32-bit integer
hints: Every cell is reached only from above or from the left, so paths[r][c] = paths[r-1][c] + paths[r][c-1].
The top row and left column each have exactly one path.
One row of the table is enough if you overwrite it left to right. There is also a pure combinatorics answer, since every path is a fixed multiset of moves.
